text:
Situation: Famotidine 20 mg tablets are not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 229 tablets at 9.8 per day (23.5 days on hand). Corvale General holds 256 tablets at 9.7 per day (26.3 days on hand). Corvale Lakeside holds 14 tablets at 1.7 per day (8.4 days on hand).

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show famotidine is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Northwind Health Company, LLC (FEI 1831143) has a registered plant with a VAI inspection on 2025-09-26 and a prior OAI inspection on 2015-12-09.

Our position: Current inventory at East and General provides adequate supply for over three weeks. Lakeside inventory is low at 8.4 days. No FDA shortage listing exists to trigger allocation protocols. Alternate manufacturers identified are not on FDA's shortage list today, though their labels name no identifiable plant.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate purchase from Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to evaluate purchase from Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to evaluate purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc.; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
4. Buyer to evaluate purchase from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
5. Buyer to evaluate purchase from Ascend Laboratories, LLC; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.

Not recommended: No immediate allocation restrictions or conservation measures at East or General given current days on hand and absence of FDA shortage listing.
